editorialMarkers: A meaning-based translation: it states in plain English what the text is saying, and renders theological terms as descriptive phrases rather than as single words. Read beside the Literal Text it shows the same verse twice — once in the shape of the original, once in the sense of it. Words in {curly braces} are information the translators judged implied rather than stated; anything longer than a phrase they put in a footnote instead. Every word is aligned to the original it stands for.
